notes: Four pages for three shapes (budget 1-2): the Haryanka article gives no date for Anga, Vajji or Kosala, and its sentences are in the Bimbisara, Ajatashatru and Vajjika League pages, so they were opened. Not settled: (1) START. The page dates the dynasty from 544 BCE (infobox) and the Magadha janapada dossier (janapada-of-magadha, other part) ends at -501 as a rename-like hand-over to this state; the -500 start is Cliopatria's row boundary. A reviewer may prefer to end janapada-of-magadha at -545 and start this dossier at -544. (2) END. The page ends the dynasty in 413 (infobox) or 425 (succession box); Cliopatria keeps the shape to -405 and starts the Shaishunaga row at -404; the Shaishunaga dossier (other group) should start in 413 to avoid a 412..405 gap. (3) Cliopatria's -450 shape holds Vatsa, Cedi, Kosala, Kasi, Malla and Vajji; the Vatsa page gives Vatsa to Avanti first (the Avanti dossier has the gain at -450), so Vatsa is cut out; Cedi is kept at confidence 1 because no page opened gives it to anyone else.
